lessons.title: Data Visualization Principles
lessons.content_md:
# Data Visualization Principles

## Why Visualize?

> *"A picture is worth a thousand words. A good chart is worth a thousand data points."*

Visualization helps:
- **Spot patterns** invisible in raw numbers
- **Communicate findings** to non-technical audiences
- **Drive action** through compelling evidence
- **Monitor** KPIs in real-time dashboards

## Choosing the Right Chart

| Data Type | Best Chart | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Comparison | Bar chart | GDP by state |
| Trend over time | Line chart | Unemployment rate 2015-2024 |
| Proportion | Pie/Donut chart | Budget allocation by ministry |
| Distribution | Histogram | Age distribution of respondents |
| Relationship | Scatter plot | Education vs. income correlation |
| Geographic | Map/Choropleth | District-wise poverty rates |
| Part-to-whole | Stacked bar | Revenue sources breakdown |

## Design Best Practices

### Do's ✅
- Use clear, descriptive titles
- Label axes with units
- Use consistent color schemes
- Start Y-axis at zero (for bar charts)
- Add data source citations

### Don'ts ❌
- Don't use 3D charts (they distort proportions)
- Don't use too many colors (max 5-7)
- Don't truncate axes misleadingly
- Don't clutter with unnecessary gridlines
- Don't use pie charts for more than 5 categories

## Color in Government Dashboards

- **Red**: Below target / critical
- **Yellow/Amber**: Warning / needs attention
- **Green**: On target / healthy
- Use colorblind-friendly palettes

lessons.title: Excel, Tableau & Power BI Overview
lessons.content_md:
# Excel, Tableau & Power BI

## Microsoft Excel

The most widely used tool in government.

### Strengths
- Universal availability (already on most govt computers)
- Familiar interface
- Pivot tables for quick analysis
- Chart creation without coding

### Key Features for DDDM
- **Pivot Tables**: Summarize large datasets instantly
- **VLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH**: Merge data from multiple sheets
- **Conditional Formatting**: Highlight anomalies
- **Charts**: Bar, line, scatter, maps
- **Power Query**: Data cleaning and transformation

### Limitations
- Row limit: ~1 million rows
- No real-time dashboards
- Manual refresh required
- Limited collaboration

## Tableau

Professional-grade visualization platform.

### Strengths
- Drag-and-drop interface
- Beautiful, interactive visualizations
- Can handle millions of rows
- **Tableau Public**: Free version

### Government Use
- NITI Aayog dashboards
- State-level SDG monitoring
- Election data visualization

## Power BI

Microsoft's business intelligence tool.

### Strengths
- Integrates with Excel and Microsoft 365
- Cloud-based real-time dashboards
- AI-powered insights
- **Power BI Desktop**: Free

### Government Use
- Ministry dashboards on NIC infrastructure
- Budget monitoring and tracking
- Performance management systems

## Tool Selection Guide

| Factor | Excel | Tableau | Power BI |
|---|---|---|---|
| Learning curve | Low | Medium | Medium |
| Data volume | <1M rows | Millions | Millions |
| Real-time | No | Yes | Yes |
| Cost | Included | Paid (Public=free) | Free desktop |
| Collaboration | Limited | Cloud-based | Cloud-based |
| Best for | Quick analysis | Publication-quality viz | Internal dashboards |
